confirmed_by.description: Operator identity string, freeform (a name+email, or an SSO identity in an enterprise attach deployment).

confirmed_at.description: Epoch ms when this mode was confirmed.

nonce.description: Random per-confirmation value, generated fresh by the confirmation CLI.

confirmation_token.description: HMAC-SHA256(secret, schema_version|mode|confirmed_by|confirmed_at|nonce), hex, keyed by the per-deployment secret at .graphsmith/state/gateway-mode.key. Recomputed and compared at every startup and by `graphsmith gateway mode status`.

pre_authorized.description: True if this confirmation was written via --use-pre-authorization rather than a live interactive session. Purely informational for audit/status purposes -- validation treats both paths identically once written.
